citations.quote: the GPD is the canonical distribution for modelling excess losses over high thresholds

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: McNeil's applied/statistical EVT mechanism for fat tails: GEV for block maxima, Pickands-Balkema-de Haan giving the GPD as the limiting excess-over-threshold law, the mean-excess diagnostic, the POT point-process model, and the Hill tail-index estimator feeding deep-tail VaR/ES, per McNeil et al. (2015) Ch.5.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Applied EVT: GPD, Peaks-Over-Threshold, and the Hill Estimator
